Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6389); Phalek (i.e. Peleg), a patriarch:--Phalec.
BiblicalUsage: Phalek is Phalec, the Greek form of Peleg, named once in the New Testament, in the genealogy of Jesus in Luke. He is the son of Eber and the father of Ragau, the patriarch in whose days the earth was divided.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Peleg's one line in the genealogy is enough: the earth was divided in his days, but the line that leads to Christ was never broken.
